title: Adding time to predictive low alert
body:
"Low predicted in 40 minutes at 6:45pm"

On the phone the notifications automatically get the minutes since rising added. On pebble watches not.

comments.body: In your example is "6:45pm" when the alert message was raised or when the Low is predicted to happen?
